text:
Symbioen monitors and verifies the performance of public and private EV chargers. 

Measuring charging performance is difficult because every operator defines it differently. The discrepancy between claimed and actual performance leads to financial and reputational risks for the sector.

To address these risks, Symbioen offers unified EV charging KPIs based on open regulatory data, allowing consistent measurement across networks. Allows comparing any network, operator, or region against a common baseline. 

For operators, Symbioen offers independent proof of network performance in front of customers, partners, and tenders. Investors and public bodies share a related need: comparable, objective data — whether for due diligence and portfolio monitoring or for understanding how charging performs across areas and regions. Site hosts and EV fleets use that same benchmarking data to hold their charging providers accountable. Symbioen's reports cover both individual site metrics and aggregated regional trends.

For questions, partnerships, or access to public or private reports, reach out at vadim@symbioen.com or visit symbioen.com.
